stem: An area of land containing living organisms may rapidly or slowly change to a surface covered with a new rock layer that does not contain any living organisms. Which statement BEST explains why this change occurs?

options.label: A
options.text: A landslide removes all soil from the area.

options.label: B
options.text: A hurricane with high winds causes erosion in the area.

options.label: C
options.text: An earthquake changes the land structures of the area.

options.label: D
options.text: A volcanic eruption causes lava to flow into the area.
